title: Fire
wikitext: '''Fire''' is an in-game Lua debugger and runtime inspector. == Installation == '''Manual Installation Only''' # Download this zip: '''[https://web.archive.org/web/20061205102638if_/http://www.cosmosui.org:80/files/distros/Cosmos_Devtools.zip Cosmos_Devtools.zip]''' # Unpack the .zip and move these files into your Interface/AddOns directory and restart the game. * '''Fire''' * '''Sea''' * '''Earth''' '''Optional''': * '''Chronos''' (delayed focus & scheduling) * '''Sky''' (slash command registration) * '''MobileFrames''' (dragging) == Command == {| class="fandom-table" !Command !Arguments !Description |- |/eval | |Evaluates a Lua expression and displays the result in Fire’s debugger tree |} == Key Bindings == {| class="fandom-table" !Action !Description !Script |- |Toggle Fire |Show/hide the main Fire window |/script ToggleFire() |- |Quick Evaluation Prompt |Open the quick eval input box |/script Fire_QuickEval() |} == Features == * Evaluate Lua expressions at runtime * Inspect globals, tables, and nested structures * Call functions and inspect return values * Filter large tables * Monitor memory & runtime behavior (via System Monitor pane) * Debug addons ''without reloading the UI'' == Preview == [[File:Fire.png|frameless|594x594px]] [[Category:Addon]]
